scope: Standalone geometry-only client using the public component API and shared native runtime. Successful bounded execution and restoration are separate from performance-target or bottleneck acceptance.

sources.delivery_scope: The separate archived 85a5 example is not the accepted-main 912 desktop or a new full-shell deployment. The managed desktop stays on the 35ed trial.

public_api_path.component: Component::view reads ViewContext.now to describe a moving rounded rectangle over an opaque semantic-token background.
public_api_path.animation: Application::animating requests continued redraw through the ordinary native frame-callback path; there is no source clock, timer, media producer, image or stream upload.
public_api_path.demand: FrameDemand tracks dirty work and pending native callbacks; ready clears pending without discarding damage, while begin admits a dirty nonpending frame.

native_contract.scope: One explicitly named virtual output; desktop widgets/bar/dock remain separate visible layers.

local_validation.scope: Actual archived example build/checks and local harness regressions; no whole-desktop retest is inferred.

presentation.window_scope: The executed helper selects requested_at_ms >= its first measurement inspect uptime. That exact lower-bound value is not saved; rates are independently recomputed from the saved selected feedback set, not the wall duration or submission counter.
presentation.quantiles: Nearest rank ceil(N*p), integer nanoseconds; no interpolation.
presentation.flags_scope: Protocol flags7 report vsync, hardware clock and hardware completion; they do not establish final pixel visibility or physical scanout.

static_visual_review.scope: Root review sees the opaque diagnostic background and part of its cyan rounded rectangle beneath separate widgets. This is partial visibility in one static image, not a full-surface, animation-smoothness or frame-by-frame pixel acceptance. Raw image and private paths are not published.

separate_operational_cleanup.scope: Subsequent owned retired-fixture cleanup and independent read-only verification. It is not a before/after performance experiment, a new security acceptance or evidence of a memory/pacing gain.

limits: The geometry-only shared native path also records below 60 feedback intervals/s in this run; no host-pressure collector ran, so this does not accept a target or attribute a compositor, renderer, driver or VM ceiling.
The35ed video run and 85a5 shape run are separate workloads and intervals. Their observed rates do not isolate decoding, upload, scheduling or compositing costs.
One partially visible screenshot does not prove whole-surface visibility, animation smoothness, frame-by-frame pixels or physical scanout.
The managed desktop remains the 35ed unmerged performance trial; accepted main 912 and its publication have their own delivery receipts.
